title: The Hidden Chamber Found by Heat
short_teaser: Thermal imaging can reveal voids, airflow, or different materials behind walls without opening them.
story: Thermal imaging can reveal voids, airflow, or different materials behind walls without opening them. A new kind of measurement can make a hidden structure visible. Discovery begins when attention stays with what does not fit long enough for a better explanation to emerge. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
